query: Starting from a W–Cu composite containing W particles or interconnected W ligaments within a Cu matrix, what single intervention could overcome phase separation and interfacial void formation, thereby improving thermal conductivity relative to the untreated composite under heat-transfer and irradiation conditions relevant to joints between W-based plasma-facing materials and Cu-based cooling components? Formulate one hypothesis that states the intervention, the proposed mechanism, the predicted comparative outcome, the applicable processing and service boundaries, supporting prior evidence, and a decisive falsification experiment.

generation.hypothesis: The W-Cu composite processed by high-energy ball milling followed by spark plasma sintering (SPS) with optimized conditions will exhibit improved thermal conductivity by at least 20% compared to the untreated composite under heat-transfer and irradiation conditions relevant to joints between W-based plasma-facing materials and Cu-based cooling components.
generation.material_initial_state: W-Cu composite with W particles or interconnected W ligaments within a Cu matrix
generation.intervention: High-energy ball milling followed by spark plasma sintering (SPS) with optimized conditions
generation.conditions: Milling energy: 300 rpm, milling time: 10 hours, SPS temperature: 800°C, pressure: 50 MPa, holding time: 30 minutes, with optimized SPS conditions to be determined through a systematic study
generation.structural_mediator: Formation of a homogeneous distribution of W particles and Cu matrix with clean and intimate interfaces
generation.mechanism: The high-energy ball milling breaks down the W particles and introduces defects, which facilitates the formation of a homogeneous distribution during SPS. The optimized SPS conditions enable the removal of interfacial voids and the formation of clean interfaces, leading to improved thermal conductivity.
generation.predicted_outcome: Improved thermal conductivity by at least 20% compared to the untreated composite under heat-transfer and irradiation conditions relevant to joints between W-based plasma-facing materials and Cu-based cooling components
generation.boundary: Heat-transfer and irradiation conditions relevant to joints between W-based plasma-facing materials and Cu-based cooling components
generation.uncertainty: The actual improvement in thermal conductivity may vary depending on the optimized SPS conditions and the specific material properties.
